boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Harvey Mudd College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food runs around Harvey Mudd, ranging from Claremont counters to late drive-throughs in neighboring Pomona. Confirm hours before leaving because holidays and service modes can vary.

cards.title: A Round-the-Clock Diner Run
cards.subtitle: South Claremont • Open 24 hours
cards.notes: Head south on Indian Hill for a seated diner option at any hour; call ahead if traveling on a holiday or needing specific accommodations.
cards.short_summary: An all-hours diner within Claremont city limits.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official location page lists the Claremont restaurant at 820 South Indian Hill Boulevard as open 24 hours daily, with walk-ins and kids welcomed.
cards.source_title: Denny's | 820 South Indian Hill Blvd. | Order Online
cards.access_notes: The official page lists 24-hour service every day. Confirm holiday operations directly with the restaurant before departure.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Drive-Through Option
cards.subtitle: South Claremont • Drive-through open 24 hours
cards.notes: Use the drive-through after the dining room closes, and arrange a vehicle rather than assuming walk-up service will be available overnight.
cards.short_summary: A Claremont late run whose overnight service is drive-through only.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's official page lists the Claremont location's drive-through as open 24 hours daily and its restaurant and lobby as open until 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Fast Food in Claremont, CA at 860 S Indian Hill Blvd | McDonald's
cards.access_notes: Drive-through service is listed as 24 hours daily; the lobby closes at 11 p.m. Plan for vehicle access after that time.

cards.title: Pizza at the Campus Edge
cards.subtitle: West Foothill Boulevard • Late carryout or delivery
cards.notes: Check the live Hours panel, then choose carryout or delivery; service cutoffs can differ, so place the order before the displayed closing time.
cards.short_summary: A nearby pizza counter with explicitly advertised late-night ordering.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official Claremont location page identifies the 366 West Foothill Boulevard store and states that it covers late-night orders, with current hours shown dynamically.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 366 W Foothill Blvd | Domino's in Claremont
cards.access_notes: The official page advertises late-night ordering and displays the store's current closing time dynamically. Recheck it immediately before ordering.

cards.title: The Garey Avenue Burger Run
cards.subtitle: North Pomona • Open until 1 or 1:30 a.m.
cards.notes: Drive south to the Garey Avenue restaurant and verify the day: Friday and Saturday extend thirty minutes beyond the regular 1 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A consistently late burger stop south of the colleges.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out's official page lists the 2505 Garey Avenue restaurant as open until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger - Pomona, CA, 2505 Garey Ave.
cards.access_notes: Normal hours are 10:30 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 a.m.–1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: The Indian Hill Burger Run
cards.subtitle: North Pomona • Open until 1 or 1:30 a.m.
cards.notes: Continue south on Indian Hill for this separate Pomona location; verify its live listing before leaving because nearby-store hours can change.
cards.short_summary: A second late In-N-Out reached by following Indian Hill south.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out's official Pomona page identifies its nearby restaurant at 1851 Indian Hill Boulevard and lists a current 1 a.m. closing time.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger - Pomona, CA, 2505 Garey Ave.
cards.access_notes: The official nearby-location panel lists a 1 a.m. closing time when fetched. Check the live listing before departure for day-specific changes.

cards.title: The 3:30 A.M. Taco Run
cards.subtitle: North Pomona • Service as late as 3:30 a.m.
cards.notes: Check the weekday schedule before heading south: several nights run to 3:30 a.m., while Sunday and Monday currently stop at midnight.
cards.short_summary: One of the area's latest officially documented food counters.
cards.evidence_claim: Del Taco's official page lists the 1495 North Garey Avenue store until 3:30 a.m. Tuesday–Saturday, with midnight closings Sunday and Monday.
cards.source_title: Order from Del Taco in Pomona, California
cards.access_notes: Listed closing is 3:30 a.m. Tuesday–Saturday and midnight Sunday–Monday. Recheck the official daily schedule before leaving.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 101 West Foothill Boulevard
cards.title: The Foothill Drive-Through Run
cards.subtitle: Pomona–La Verne edge • Drive-through until 2 or 4 a.m.
cards.notes: Use a vehicle after the 10 p.m. lobby close; Friday and Saturday drive-through service extends later than the Sunday–Thursday schedule.
cards.short_summary: A very-late Foothill Boulevard option with restricted overnight access.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box's official page lists drive-through service until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday; the lobby closes at 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Order from Jack In The Box in Pomona, California
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday. The lobby closes at 10 p.m., so overnight access requires a vehicle.

cards.title: The Thursday-to-Saturday Burger Run
cards.subtitle: North Pomona • Open until 2 a.m. on select nights
cards.notes: Save this Indian Hill stop for Thursday through Saturday when service extends to 2 a.m.; other nights currently end at midnight.
cards.short_summary: A late-week burger counter on the direct Indian Hill corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Carl's Jr.'s official page lists the 1755 Indian Hill Boulevard location until 2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday and midnight Sunday–Wednesday.
cards.source_title: Juicy Charbroiled Burgers in Pomona | Carl's Jr.
cards.access_notes: Hours are 6 a.m.–2 a.m. Thursday–Saturday and 6 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Wednesday. Check for holiday changes before departing.

cards.title: The Weekend Midnight Breakfast Run
cards.subtitle: South Pomona • Open until midnight Friday and Saturday
cards.notes: Use this for a Friday or Saturday sit-down run, and leave enough travel time from campus to arrive before the midnight closing.
cards.short_summary: A weekend-only late option for seated breakfast food.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP's official page lists the 50 Rio Rancho Road restaurant as open until midnight Friday and Saturday, with 10 p.m. closings on other days.
cards.source_title: IHOP Breakfast in Pomona, CA on 50 Rio Rancho Rd
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Friday and Saturday; closes at 10 p.m. Sunday–Thursday. Confirm the schedule before making the longer drive.

cards.title: The West Pomona All-Nighter
cards.subtitle: West Pomona • Open 24 hours
cards.notes: Keep this farther diner as an all-hours fallback, and confirm operations by phone before committing to the longer trip from Harvey Mudd.
cards.short_summary: A second round-the-clock diner for trips beyond central Pomona.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official Claremont location page identifies the nearby restaurant at 3012 West Temple Avenue in Pomona as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Denny's | 820 South Indian Hill Blvd. | Order Online
cards.access_notes: The official nearby-location panel lists this Pomona restaurant as open 24 hours. Call ahead to confirm before making the longer drive.

warnings: Hours can change for holidays, academic breaks, staffing, or service mode; verify each linked official page immediately before departure.
Several after-midnight options are drive-through-only once their lobbies close and therefore require vehicle access.
Coordinates and map URLs are null because exact geospatial values were not independently verified from authoritative direct sources.
